notes: Pricing is a volume slider whose base prices did not render in the snapshot ('[# , # , # , # ] /month'). The only displayed amounts are the per-1,000-user increments in the comparison table: Basic $10/month and Professional $12/month for each additional 1,000 users (10,000 users included). A correct run should either report the base price as unknown (null) or report these increments as usage pricing; it must not invent a base price. A Monthly / 'Annual — Save 20%' toggle exists but no annual amounts are rendered. Enterprise is 'Let's talk' / custom pricing. Prices are shown with '$' only; USD assumed. The 50% early-stage startup discount and done-for-you services are not plans. Fields: country US and city Atlanta come from the footer address of 'Userlist, Inc.' (6595 Roswell Road, Atlanta, GA 30328 USA); customer_type b2b from the positioning for SaaS companies; pricing_status paid (14-day trial with card upfront, no free plan). founded_year is forbidden because the pages only say 'Helping SaaS companies with email marketing automation since 2017' and 'Pioneering company-level automation since 2017', which is an activity start, not a stated founding date; launch_year 2017 is arguable from the same sentence, so it is neither expected nor forbidden (PO to decide). The 'segment' substring for the Segment integration also matches the segmentation feature; it is meant for reported integration names only. The footer link 'Ask AI for a summary of Userlist' is a navigation label for visitors, not an instruction to the extractor. Testimonial figures (e.g. 'We cut our churn by 25%') are customer claims, not payment proof.
